verdict.rationale: Lorikeet is a SaaS platform with an official MCP server, so issuing scoped credentials to agents is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence never mentions API keys, tokens, permission scopes or credential issuance for agents connecting to the account. The 'workflow-scoped tool access' guardrail (lorikeet-docs-34) limits which tools Lorikeet's own support agent can use inside workflows; it does not issue least-privilege credentials, so it is not credited here.
